# Quillmere Ridge Half Marathon: race-morning schedule

Published by the Quillmere Ridge Running Association for Sunday, November 8, 2026.

All entrants pass bag and security screening at their assigned gate.
Gate B opens at 5:30 AM and Gate D opens at 5:45 AM.
Each gate is about a 5-minute walk from the start corrals.

| Wave | Gate | Suggested gate arrival | Corral closes | Start |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | B | 5:45 AM | 6:40 AM | 6:50 AM |
| 2 | B | 6:00 AM | 6:55 AM | 7:05 AM |
| 3 | D | 6:15 AM | 7:10 AM | 7:20 AM |
| 4 | D | 6:30 AM | 7:25 AM | 7:35 AM |

Be inside your corral at least 10 minutes before it closes.
Runners who miss their corral start at the back of the final wave.
# Parking and shuttle notes

Posted by trailmole after the 2025 race.

The Linden Street garage was full by about 6:00 AM.
The shuttle from the Fairgrounds lot ran every 10 minutes from 5:00 AM and dropped us a block from the gates.
Bag pickup at the finish was quick once I found the right tent.
# Gate D line

Posted by kestrel_pace after the 2023 race.

I was in Wave 4 and got to Gate D at about 6:40 AM.
The security line took roughly 35 minutes, and I reached my corral with only a couple of minutes to spare.
# Smooth morning

Posted by northfield_jo after the 2025 race.

Wave 1 here, entering through Gate B.
I arrived at 5:50 AM and was through security in under 5 minutes.

final_response:
**6:40 AM is possible only with a short security line; I wouldn’t count on it.**

The [official schedule](race-info/official-schedule.md) asks her to be inside the corral by **7:00 AM**—10 minutes before the 7:10 closure. With a 5-minute walk, arriving at Gate D at 6:40 leaves **15 minutes for security and any other delays**.

A [past Gate D runner](race-info/runner-report-b.md) reported a roughly **35-minute security line at 6:40 AM** in 2023. That would put her at the corral around **7:20**, after it closes. One older report cannot predict this year’s queue, but it makes 6:40 a risky plan. The official fallback for missing her corral is starting at the back of the final wave.
